flexible_assembly_notes.scope: Static reference routing. Continuous motion and real cable bend limits not validated.

appearance.scheme: Black anodized CNC with red accents; black stepper bodies, silver endcaps/shafts and leadscrews
appearance.note: STEP contains SURFACE_STYLE_TRANSPARENT; importer display support varies.

motion_preview.coordinates: X/Y use official cfg numerical ranges with the endpoint registered to nominal six-degree lever depression; electrical actuation is not calibrated. Z is bed lowering from CAD reference pose.
motion_preview.method: Rigid XY gantry/head and Z bed/carriage translations, exact nominal endstop contact curves, flexible routing preview. No firmware/thermal/flexible-body solver.

endstop_registration.method: Exact BREP first contact for each rigid lever rotation about the CAD hinge. Nominal homing depression = 6 degrees. Electrical actuation threshold unknown.

pressed_detail_step.scope: Both depressed switches and their shared Y carriage actuator parts at X350/Y360. No full-machine geometry.

endstop_registration.lever_housing_overlap_note: Old integrated-body overlap is the moving plunger. After separating and retracting this exact source plunger, the lever has zero case intersection. Internal guide cavity/snap mechanism is not modeled.

display_notices: The 300 mm sized members come from the native 300 mm source. Rigid hardware keeps its reviewed dimensions.
Reference chain and wiring routes are display geometry; full physical travel and wiring bend limits are not certified.
Eight duplicated or surplus rail screw occurrences are omitted; native fixing positions are retained.
